race.comment: LOTTA CITY (10) resumes with a solid profile. She's 1 from 9 but is rarely far away and draws for a soft run. She's yet to miss a place in three starts here at home and with a key danger coming out she should take beating. HEY KLEINE MAUS (9) worked home well fresh at Seymour on firm going to grab third over 1000m. Up in trip will suit better now and we'll get a guide to that form via Gunz earlier. DRAGON SCROLL (1) was okay first up at Cranbourne in a 955m but that was a BM78 and the tempo here will be much kinder, she should give a strong sight on speed. BRUTAL WORLD (3) is racing well with two wins in a row before bumping into two smart ones at Cranbourne. She can bounce right back.
